purpose: Prevent a Paper-IV terminal decision, especially NEW_REQUIRED, from being inferred from a benchmark set that omits materially distinct major quantum-gravity schools or silently lets one scoped submodel stand for an entire school.

coverage_basis.primary_reference: Bambi, Modesto, Shapiro (eds.), Handbook of Quantum Gravity, Springer 2024, DOI 10.1007/978-981-99-7681-2
additional_independent_programs: Group Field Theory / tensor models: kept distinct because related formulations can have different Hilbert spaces and dynamics despite spin-foam links
Causal Fermion Systems: already an active independent KMQGB branch

tier1_required_rows.name: General Relativity plus controlled low-energy gravitational EFT
Perturbative renormalizable / higher-derivative quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze at least one physically complete renormalizable higher-derivative realization with propagator/pole prescription, unitarity interpretation, normalized observable and GR/EFT comparator; family-level exclusion requires a theorem or materially distinct subfamily audit.

tier1_required_rows.name: Hořava-Lifshitz quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a healthy declared variant with symmetry/projectability choice, RG/UV authority, IR GR map, extra-mode consistency and a normalized observable/comparator package.

tier1_required_rows.name: Nonlocal / infinite-derivative quantum gravity
closed_subbenchmarks: Ricci/EOM-squared weakly-nonlocal tree S-matrix class: exact GR comparator identity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: The Ricci/EOM-squared weakly nonlocal tree-S-matrix subclass is closed as an exact GR comparator identity. Resolve the materially distinct Riemann/Weyl nonlocal branch and any retained loop/non-scattering branch, then provide family-level exhaustion/equivalence authority before terminal coverage.

tier1_required_rows.name: String / M-theory / holographic quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.note: The existing dual-resonance/Virasoro-Shapiro rigidity benchmark is scoped evidence, not a proof about the entire string/M-theory/holography family.

tier1_required_rows.name: Causal Set quantum gravity
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a declared dynamics/measure plus continuum-emergence regime and at least one normalized causal-set gravity observable with identical-domain GR/EFT and alternative-QG comparators.

tier1_required_rows.name: Causal/Euclidean Dynamical Triangulations
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Freeze a 4D phase/continuum-limit realization and an invariant observable with lattice-spacing/finite-size/systematic error control and identical-domain comparators.

tier1_required_rows.name: Group Field Theory / tensor models
tier1_required_rows.minimum_resolution: Determine first whether the chosen GFT/tensor realization reduces to the already tested spinfoam row or carries independent dynamics; if independent, freeze its continuum/condensate map and a normalized comparator-ready observable.

tier2_resolution_watchlist.required_action: Map into perturbative/string coverage or promote to Tier1 if it supplies materially independent UV dynamics/observables.
Determine whether a current quantum-gravity realization supplies independent dynamics and comparator-ready observables; otherwise document scope exclusion.
Determine whether the program is a calculational representation/subframework or an independent quantum-gravity dynamics class.
Determine whether it defines an independent complete candidate realization for the Paper-IV target or is a quantization framework lacking a distinct closed observable package.
Split only materially complete, independently predictive programs into Tier1; do not use a generic catch-all as exclusion evidence.
